articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that merges the capabilities previously split across separate models. Benchmarks show substantial gains in PhD-level science QA and complex code generation, with a new 'deep thinking' mode that can chain reasoning steps over minutes for hard problems.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New Marks on Agentic Coding and Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with a two-million-token context window and significantly improved agentic task completion. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench and GPQA Diamond, and introduces a new 'deep research' agent mode capable of autonomously navigating the web, synthesizing multi-source reports, and citing findings with verifiable references.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 02 Humanoids at BMW Spartanburg Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the start of scaled commercial deployment of its Figure 02 humanoid robots at BMW's Spartanburg, SC manufacturing facility, moving beyond pilot programs to multi-shift production roles. The robots handle bin picking, parts transfer, and visual quality inspection, using on-board vision-language models for zero-shot task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Prototype Demonstrates Fluid Bipedal Walking and Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot prototype with dramatically improved locomotion and 22-degree-of-freedom hands capable of manipulating small objects like eggs and electronic components. The system uses an end-to-end neural network policy trained in simulation and transferred to hardware, marking a significant step toward Tesla's goal of deploying units in its own factories by late 2026.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration for Multi-Agent Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise platform layer enabling Claude models to act as orchestrating agents that delegate subtasks to specialized sub-agents, manage tool calls across APIs, and maintain long-running stateful workflows. The system includes built-in guardrails, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints designed for regulated industries such as finance and healthcare.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of A14 2nm Node, Enabling Next-Gen AI Accelerator Chips
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that risk production on its N2 (2nm) process node using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors has begun, with initial wafers allocated to Apple and NVIDIA. The node offers approximately 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction compared to N3E, which is expected to be transformative for next-generation AI training and inference accelerators shipping in 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Reliable Logical Qubits with Record-Low Error Rates
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing below-threshold error rates on logical qubits using a new hybrid error-correction scheme on Quantinuum's trapped-ion hardware. The team demonstrated reliable execution of circuits with over 100 logical operations, representing a critical milestone toward fault-tolerant quantum computing and validating Microsoft's topological-hybrid roadmap.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Performs Autonomous Disaster-Site Navigation in DARPA Field Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' fully electric Atlas humanoid completed DARPA-supervised field trials involving autonomous navigation through collapsed building environments, stair climbing over debris, and valve manipulation tasks without remote teleoperation. The robot used a combination of LiDAR SLAM, onboard vision-language models for semantic scene understanding, and whole-body MPC for dynamic balance on uneven terrain.
